svg.title: Message bus semantic sigil (Mosofin)
svg.desc: Verbatim geometry from mosofin/renderers/shared/utils.mjs SIGIL_SHAPE.messagebus (tone messagebus). In the viewer the group is placed at translate(nodeX+6, nodeY+6) scale(0.6875) and inherits fill none, stroke currentColor, stroke-width 1.35, round caps and joins, opacity 0.76. currentColor resolves to --messagebus-stroke: #ea580c (light) / #ea580c (dark).
